text:
people_ops_anna: Quick open thread from the all-hands pricing section — drop short Qs about billing, quotas, rate limits, credits, or fallback behavior and leadership will answer.

eng_ash: If a dev accidentally shares a project key across forks, will one noisy fork cause 429s for everyone?

cto_jen: Yes, project-level quotas mean a noisy client can exhaust the project budget. Best practice: use separate projects per environment or enable org-level quotas for global control.

sre_noah: What windows do we enforce? Per-second? Per-minute? Need to tune alerts.

cto_jen: Multiple windows: per-second concurrency controls, per-minute token throughput, and daily token caps for billing. Monitor per-minute for throughput spikes and per-second for streaming/concurrency issues.

eng_ash: Is there an API to poll remaining quota so CI can pause before hitting limits?

product_maya: Yep. Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/projects/PROJECT_ID/remaining
```

finance_lena: Small note on credits: trial credits expire 90 days after issuance and cannot be transferred between projects. Enterprise promos can be org-applied if requested during redemption.

eng_ash: If a request gets 429 do we ever auto-downgrade model to a smaller one or is it a hard fail?

cto_jen: Default is a hard 429. We offer an opt-in routing policy that can failover to compatible/cheaper model variants if you configure it for a route. We won't silently downgrade without explicit policy.

sre_noah: Any recommended retry pattern? CI failed a job earlier.

product_maya: Use exponential backoff with jitter and honor Retry-After. Our SDKs include a retry helper you can use. For background processing consider batching or a dedicated project.

billing_bot: [billing] Promo credit expirations are shown in Console -> Billing -> Credits. Contact billing@redwood.ai for special cases.

people_ops_anna: Thanks everyone — we'll publish a short FAQ with examples (project vs org quotas, curl/SDK snippets, burst credits) and link it here when live. :thumbsup:
